dialogues.speaker: Beautifully-Written Note
dialogues.text: "Bertin's House of Curiosities purchases all types of antiques and exotic crafts. If interested, please contact us."

dialogues.speaker: Beautifully-Written Note
dialogues.text: "Looking for valuable collectibles of various sorts. Offering pleasing prices that are sure not to disappoint."

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Cassigneul's Reply
dialogues.text: "Many thanks for choosing to post your notice in this harbor, Ms. Mequignon."

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Cassigneul's Reply
dialogues.text: "However, when purchasing collectibles, do be selective and choose those you deal with very carefully. Otherwise, you may find yourself in unnecessary disputes."
